# Hollingworth Pay — gateway journal (node hgw-eu-2)

One journal per node per day, written by the gateway process. Record
lines read:

    <UTC timestamp> <LEVEL> <service> <message>

Three writer services share this journal:

- hollingworth-pay — card authorisations and captures
- hollingworth-pay-3ds — the step-up authentication service (3-D Secure)
- hollingworth-ledger — posting of settled amounts

The service field is the third token; each line belongs only to the
service named there. The last line of the journal is a CLOSE record whose
records= count covers the record lines above it.
